features.item: cordless handheld vacuum lifting device with integrated battery power
features.note: (non-English passage at paragraph p0003) The reference describes a self-sufficient device that can temporarily attach an object to a surface without needing mains voltage or a connection cable, indicating a cordless, battery-powered device.
features.quote_src: Die erfindungsgemässe Befestigungseinrichtung bildet ein autarkes Gerät aus, mit dem ein Gegenstand zeitweilig an einem Untergrund, insbesondere einer Wand oder einer Decke, befestigt werden kann, ohne dass eine Netzspannung und ein Anschlusskabel bereitgestellt werden müssen.

features.note: (non-English passage at paragraph p0005) The reference explicitly states that the sealing ring held on the suction plate is made of an elastically deformable material, adaptable to curved surfaces, and gap-filling to seal the area around the suction plate.

features.note: (non-English passage at paragraph p0003) The abstract states that the suction plate is integrated into a housing which houses the vacuum pump, battery, and electrical switching element, indicating the pump is mounted within a rigid body.
